remarks: Discover the perfect blend of convenience, privacy, and security in the sought-after Mill River House. This rare 2-3 bedroom, 2-bath Penthouse offers an expansive open floor plan with soaring 10+ ft ceilings and stunning two-story east-facing windows that provide views of Mill River Park & flood the space with natural light. The modern kitchen features a center island and granite countertops, while the private balcony, accessible from both the living room and primary bedroom, provides for a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city & lovely views of the park. The primary suite boasts a spacious walk-in California closet and a full bath with a tub/shower combo. A second bedroom, also with a walk-in closet, and another full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, a versatile loft leads to a bonus room-ideal as a 3rd bedroom or home office. Additional highlights include central air, natural gas heating, and in-unit laundry. Residents enjoy premium amenities, including a fitness center, clubhouse, landscaped garden with picnic areas and grills, and secured garage parking. This doorman, pet-friendly, elevator-accessible building is adjacent to Mill River Park, offering year-round entertainment with concerts, food truck festivals, outdoor movies, jogging trails, a carousel, and an ice skating rink. Just minutes from acclaimed dining and public transportation, this Penthouse is city living at its finest!
